audit.whatIsWrong: The chart read Skill/Yone/Yone/Skill/Skill for levels 1 through 6 while every matching why said Ambessa wins that stage ('bully your level-1 approach', 'still out-trades you', 'keeps trades in her favour', 'out-duel you', 'a kill threat'). The packet chart gives Ambessa all five of those rows.
audit.why: The page was rendering Yone-favoured rows above Ambessa-favoured reasons.
audit.corrected: win[0..4] and phases[0..4].side = Ambessa; First item and Two+ items stay Yone. phases[0..2].why rewritten to match.

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldowns stated for the abilities the whole page is built around.
audit.why: Repudiation is 18/17/16/15/14s and Public Execution is 130/115/100s — the longest ultimate cooldown in the matchup. Those numbers are what make 'wait for her window' actionable.
audit.corrected: Both written into breakdown.cooldowns, spikes[0], spikes[1] and mid.

audit.whatIsWrong: Fabricated ability names and a fabricated mechanic. spikes[0] calls her W 'Repel/Cutthroat' and describes it as a 'dash-and-recall'; early and mid repeat 'her W dash tools' and 'the W dash-recall'; the focus field and the entire full layer track a non-existent ability called 'Repeating Dashes'. Ambessa's W is Repudiation: a shield plus a braced slam at 325 range that GROUNDS. Her dashes come from Drakehound's Step (P), fired by inputting a move/attack command during a cast, and from Lacerate (E).
audit.why: The grounding is the decisive interaction and the page never mentions it: while grounded your Mortal Steel two-stack dash and Fate Sealed's blink simply do not fire, which removes both your engage and your escape. Public Execution is also a suppression into a stun, not a plain lockdown — no dash gets you out once it lands.
audit.corrected: Real names used throughout; Repudiation's ground written into the tldr-adjacent fields, spikes, early, mid, late, wants and the don'ts.

audit.whatIsWrong: Drakehound's Step is an auto-attack empowerment triggered by the player's input during a cast — the wind-up, not the ability, is the tell.
audit.why: Reacting to the ability cast is always one beat too late against her.

edits.before: Ambessa is a lane bully — her W (Repel/Cutthroat) dash-and-recall plus her chained Q spins let her burst you and reposition out. Her level 3-5 all-in with the W engage is strong; don't trade into her when her dashes are up.
edits.after: Ambessa is a lane bully — Cunning Sweep (Q) hits a 650 semicircle and transforms into Sundering Slam on hit, and Drakehound's Step dashes her out of every cast. Repudiation (W, 18s) grounds you: your Q3 dash dies inside it.

edits.before: Ambessa R (Public Execution) is a targeted dash-lockdown that sets up her full combo — a real kill threat at 6. Keep your E and Flash for her R; if you eat it at low HP with your cooldowns down, you die.
edits.after: Public Execution (R, 130s at rank 1) blinks her to the farthest champion in a line and suppresses you, then slams for a stun — no dash gets you out once it starts. Save Flash for the wind-up, and never sit at low HP.

edits.before: Ambessa is one of the scariest early lane bullies you'll face — her mobility and chained Q spins let her engage, burst, and dash back out before you can answer. Levels 1-2 you should concede short trades and focus on not dying: her W dash tools make her all-in far stronger than yours this early. Don't get greedy on CS inside her engage range.
edits.after: Ambessa is one of the scariest early lane bullies you'll face — Drakehound's Step gives her a dash out of every cast, so she engages, bursts and leaves before you answer. Levels 1-2 concede the short trades: Repudiation shields her, and its ground kills your Q3 dash mid-fight. Don't get greedy on CS inside her Q range.

edits.before: This stays hard through the entire early-to-mid game. From level 3 to 5 her combo damage and the W dash-recall out-trade you, and at 6 Public Execution gives her a targeted lockdown that chains straight into a kill combo. Hold your E and Flash specifically for her R — burning them to trade is how you lose the lane. Play the wave, take safe CS, and wait for her cooldown windows.
edits.after: This stays hard through the early-to-mid game. From 3 to 5 her chained Q into Lacerate out-trades you, and at 6 Public Execution suppresses you into a stun that no dash escapes. Hold Soul Unbound and Flash for her ultimate — burning them to trade is how you lose the lane. Repudiation is 18s at rank 1, and that gap is the window you farm and poke in.

edits.before: The matchup finally turns at first item: your W shield and sustained mixed DPS let you eat her front-loaded burst and win the long fight she can't sustain. With two-plus items you're clearly ahead — bait her W dashes, use E to dodge her R lockdown chain, and grind her down once her combo no longer one-shots you.
edits.after: The matchup turns at first item: Spirit Cleave's shield and sustained mixed DPS let you eat her front-loaded burst and win the long fight she can't sustain. With two-plus items you're clearly ahead — bait Repudiation out, commit once its ground is gone, and grind her down when her combo no longer one-shots you.
